title: Windmill Treat Dispenser Dog Toy
description: The TRIXIE Windmill Activity Strategy Game is an interactive puzzle toy designed to provide mental stimulation and enrichment for medium-breed dogs. It features a light green central hub with four clear/blue cylindrical beaker tubes that dispense treats or kibble as the dog spins them. The toy includes two different patterned end caps (single-hole and tri-hole) to adjust the difficulty level and flow of food, making it suitable as both a strategy game and a slow feeder for fast eaters. The unit is supported by a light green stand on a black base with non-slip rubber feet for stability, and the beakers are dishwasher safe for easy cleaning.

title: TRIXIE Solitaire Dog Activity Strategy Game Dog Toy

This interactive toy is ideal for young dogs or those new to puzzle games, helping to ease anxiety and foster a bonding experience between pet and owner.

description: This TRIXIE puzzle toy is designed as a Level 1 strategy game to mentally stimulate dogs. description: This is an automatic fish feeder from Lifegard Aquatics, designed for use with various aquarium setups.
